backlogged.summary: The section-extraction helper in test/f73-claude-md-keep-going.test.mjs relies on the section ending at the first blank line. If a blank line is later added inside the section, the AC-4 deepEqual would fail, which is arguably intended strictness.

The managed block in this repository's CLAUDE.md is marked v2.0.28, while the harness version may differ. AC-6 passes because freshness is judged by content, not version, so this is only a cosmetic marker mismatch.
